findings: Learner overview: clarify that 艮 is proposed as a sound cue because its reconstructed Old Chinese form is similar to 很’s, while the match is approximate. The current overview calls it an “approximate sound cue” but does not explain the basis for that relationship; evidence X-49bd7f9b1d2371818776 and X-3e01d4bc57e80771972d support the comparison.
